svg.aria-label: Stacks of five coin cells: SS | electrolyte | SS measures ionic conductivity and electronic conductivity; SS | PTFE | SS is the blank cell for electronic conductivity; Li | electrolyte | Li measures transference number, symmetric cycling and critical current density; SS | electrolyte | Li measures the stability window; SS | wetted separator | SS measures the effective conductivity of a liquid electrolyte. All are assembled from bottom to top.

text.style: fill:rgb(19, 28, 38);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700

svg.text: 5 cells: same order, only electrodes differ (top = cap side)
